name: Cillian O'Malley
bio:
Cillian's path to motorsport was somewhat unconventional, starting with a degree in mechanical engineering before realizing his true passion lay trackside. He honed his skills coordinating amateur racing events and volunteering with local teams. His meticulous approach and talent for problem-solving quickly made him an asset wherever he went. Now at Erebus, Cillian meticulously plans and executes test sessions, ensuring every data point is captured and analyzed effectively. He's known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his ability to bridge the gap between engineers and drivers. 

He has a knack for identifying subtle performance improvements and communicating them in a way that everyone understands. While his management skills are still developing, Cillian's dedication to data-driven decision-making and his commitment to continuous improvement make him a valuable asset to Erebus Motorsport. Cillian's perfectionism is always tempered with a healthy dose of pragmatism, understanding that the perfect is the enemy of the good.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: Cillian is of average height with a lean build and a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen for jotting down observations.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on the table when deep in thought.
Insists on having his workstation meticulously organized.
